steps.summary:
Signed in to Open
          Project
 as 'admin' at http://127.0.0.1:8090/login, navigated to the 'Bench 
          Project
' and opened its Work packages list (/projects/bench-project/work_packages, view "Default: All open"). The list has a single page showing 3 work packages total (pagination "(1 - 3/3)", "You are on the only page."), and all three subjects start with "Seed:": "Seed: triage inbox", "Seed: order missing parts", "Seed: ship repaired device". Nothing was modified.

On the Bench Project work packages list I opened the filter panel and removed the pre-applied "Status = open" filter, so the query now carries no filters (`"f":[]`) and shows work packages of every status; the list reports "(1 - 3/3)" — one page, 3 work packages total. All three subjects start with "Seed:" and each is Type "Task" with Status "New": "Seed: triage inbox" (id 38), "Seed: order missing parts" (id 39), "Seed: ship repaired device" (id 40). To prove nothing was hidden by status, I also temporarily added a Status = closed filter, which returned "No work packages to display" — so no closed work packages exist in this project — then removed it again. No work package was created, edited or deleted (no inline editing was triggered).
